name: ui_type
description: Type text into a UI field on a connected device. Optionally targets a specific field by resource-id or text label (taps to focus first). Set clear=true to erase existing text first, submit=true to press Enter after typing. If no field selector is given, types into the currently focused field.

clear.description: Clear existing text in the field before typing (default: false)

content_desc.description: Content-description of the field to type into

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)

exact.description: Match id/text_match/content_desc by full-string equality (case-insensitive) instead of the default substring match.

id.description: Resource ID of the text field to type into (optional -- types into focused field if omitted)

text_match.description: Visible text or hint text of the field to type into

arguments.description: Generated MCP request struct for this tool.
arguments.title: UiTypeRequest
